decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Design and Access Statement, received on 13/07/2012, 002b, received on 15/08/2012 and 003c, received on 19/08/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The terrace shall not be used until the balustrade has been installed in accordance with the submitted plans. The balustrade shall be maintained in that position thereafter.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, erection of a rear and side roof extension with two roof windows to the front of the house.
